name: gen-matrix
description: Gen Matrix — a Civitai App Block (W10 full-page) that generates a bounded grid of (checkpoint × modifier) cells so users can compare how each model/style changes the output. Spends real Buzz per cell via the page money path (estimate → consent → submit → poll), with a concurrency-limited queue, a client-side cell cap, and a confirm-before-spend total-cost gate. The LoRA second axis submits checkpoint + LoRA pairings live; compatibility is deferred to the server (incompatible pairings are rejected pre-spend and shown as muted/blocked, costing 0).
